findings: PowerGovernor.stateFor maps NaN and -Infinity to NOMINAL/native while +Infinity maps to TERMINAL/shadow; assertWithinEnvelope does not reject NaN. Translation must preserve this behavior or require a separately approved correction.

Construction validates the envelope once but retains the mutable object reference; later mutation changes thresholds without revalidation and AEROSPACE_ENVELOPE is not frozen at runtime. The injected sensor is also retained by reference, runs on every evaluate, can throw or mutate state, and has no freshness, hysteresis or terminal latch.

requestAdjustment(shadow) grants at TERMINAL; only a separate assertWithinEnvelope call throws. The governor does not switch kernels or shut down hardware, and native sensor access/HybridEngine switching remain deferred seams.

The existing Fungi twin contains six decision flows but envelopeValid receives comparison booleans without an explicit finiteness check; an Infinity threshold can satisfy those predicates while TypeScript rejects it. Host admission must bind finiteness and exact numeric comparisons.

Fungi kernelForState maps every code other than 0/1 to shadow, while the TypeScript switch has no fallback outside its four string states; killSwitchVerdict rejects only code 3. Preserve canonical label/code mapping, unknown kernel rank -1, numeric comparisons, error identity/messages and evaluation order.

RD-0361 covers interpreter/Wasm String ranks and exhaustive bounded decision folds plus selected TypeScript cases; it does not establish complete governor equivalence, finite-envelope marshalling, host sensor correctness, hardware enforcement or aerospace certification.
